title: stone rubys
description: this mod adds rubys for getting large amounts of iron or andesite best used with create
body:
Stone Rubys adds two new items to Minecraft, designed to help you mass-produce resources -- especially useful alongside the Create mod.

## Items
- **Cold Ruby** -- Crafted from a single cobblestone. Smelt it in a furnace to obtain a Stone Ruby.
- **Stone Ruby** -- Used to duplicate items, producing large quantities of iron, andesite, and more.

## Create Compatibility
Best used alongside [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create). The Stone Ruby enables an andesite duplication recipe, making it a great early-game resource booster for Create-based factories.

**Requirements:** NeoForge | Minecraft 1.21.1 | Singleplayer only
